item.title: Mothers in Pagasae & the Agora hang buckthorn on the doors: the child Xendotos Lykgenides
item.description: Mothers in Pagasae & the Agora hang buckthorn on the doors: the child Xendotos Lykgenides ~1104 is restless, and comes to the window at night.

item.title: The fire under Xendotos Lykgenides ~1104 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar
item.description: The fire under Xendotos Lykgenides ~1104 has gone out. The bones were gathered and an oar was planted on the mound in the Asphodel Meadow.

item.title: A child of the Argyreoi, Xendotos Lykgenides ~1104, died before their fifth year. The Sown
item.description: A child of the Argyreoi, Xendotos Lykgenides ~1104, died before their fifth year. The Sown parents do not understand grief, and learn it.
